main_title: The Flight of the Condor and the Eagle
main_sub: God is ONE ❤️ and Yaldabaoth is EGO 🧠
header_desc: Gnosis allows us to understand who we really are in the universe. While the first coming of Christ was linked to matter, the second is related to time. This reveals to us that human consciousness transcends both —a truth explained from spirituality with the certainty that God is One (the Condor) and complemented by modern physics (the Eagle)—
left_title: The Christian cross is the key ✝️ to awakening ❤️ from the illusion of the Demiurge 🧠: matter and time ┻
left_body: Matter tells spacetime how to curve, and spacetime tells matter how to move. If the ego curves spacetime, the temporal plane of the cosmos emerges from our psyche 🧠, while the timeless belongs to the pneuma ❤️. In this context, the premise that the Father and I are one invites detaching from the false self to return to the pure light of the Invisible Father. Thus, the Pleroma is revealed as a flat spacetime opposite to the material prison of curved spacetime.
universe_light_text: Understanding that death is not an absolute end but a transformation releases us from ignorance. In the right hemisphere, our pneuma dwells in the timeless and divine plane, the high-frequency dimension | 999⟩. There lies the land of union and freedom (The Great Homeland).
center_text: The Kingdom of God is inside you and it is outside you (Gospel of Thomas, Saying 3): The Gnostic gospels have hidden, for two millennia, the ultimate key to quantum gravity. The demiurgic ego possesses mass and creates the materio-temporal illusion; therefore, only through the feeling of Sophia is it possible to access the divine and timeless plane of the cosmos.
universe_mat_text: The human body is composed of carbon-12 (6p^+, 6e^-, 6n^0). In the left hemisphere lies the temporal and material plane, the low-frequency dimension | 666⟩. Gravitational force drags us to a place where: war is peace, freedom is slavery, and ignorance is strength (1984).
final_quote: When the Northern Eagle and the Southern Condor fly together in the same sky, Mother Earth will awaken and humanity will heal
p2_sub: Condor and Eagle: The flight of science and spirituality
cap1_title: Chapter 1: The Prophecy of the Condor and the Eagle footnotesize color{golddark}(00:10 -- 01:07)
cap1_desc: Premise and integration framework: the reconciliation between the intuitive wisdom of the South (the heart, ancestral knowledge, and spirit) and the technological development of the North (reason, science, and mind). The call for balance to initiate the evolutionary awakening and transcend the state of duality.
cap2_title: Chapter 2: Quantum Gravity and the Illusion of Time (01:13 -- 02:42)
cap2_desc: The fundamental clash of theoretical physics: General Relativity versus Quantum Mechanics. Why Newton's and Maxwell's laws do not distinguish between past and future, the rupture of simultaneity by Einstein, and the dissolution of linear time as a neural reconstruction of memory.
cap3_desc: The conceptual ensemble Faggin--Segarra: the body as a vehicle operated by a conscious quantum field outside spacetime, where qualia reside. Consciousness does not arise from the brain but precedes it, converging with the First Consciousness and the Intelligent Designer free of time and space.
cap4_desc: The Nag Hammadi find (1945) and the Coptic codices: the material cosmos conceived not as a home, but as a confinement of the soul. The teaching of the Gospel of Thomas (Logion 3): Jesus did not come to found a religion of dogmas but to free the inner spark from the prison of the Demiurge through remembrance (gnosis).
cap5_title: Chapter 5: The Pleroma of Light and The Material Prison (08:43 -- 10:16)
cap5_desc: The time of no-time and the awakening announced by Mayan cosmology. The cosmological question about the origin of Yaldabaoth and the revelation of the Pleroma: the transcendent realm of perfection, silence, and pure light where the Invisible Father dwells, emanated through Sophia (wisdom).
cap6_title: Chapter 6: The Dajjal and the Brain Hemispheres (10:23 -- 14:38)
cap6_desc: The compared eschatology and the perceptual distortion: the figure of the Dajjal and the visual trick of the inverted paradise (the river and the fire). The mechanism of Orwellian doublethink (1984) as the cognitive prison of the ego, against the revolutionary message of Jesus that dismantles the imperial slavery system.
cap7_title: Chapter 7: Reflections on Our Place in the Cosmos (14:40 -- 16:30)
cap7_desc: The central affirmation: I am the way, the truth, and the life; the Father and I are one (John 14:6). The confrontation before the question of questions: Is Jesus God in an immeasurable universe of more than two trillion galaxies? The paradox of cosmic incarnation on a tiny planet.
sagan_quote: The idea that God is a big white man, larger than normal, with a flaming beard, sitting in the sky counting the fall of every sparrow, is ridiculous. But if by God one means the set of physical laws governing the universe, then clearly such a God exists. However, this God is emotionally unsatisfying... it doesn't make much sense to pray to the law of gravity
